children: Elon Musk said Tesla’s Full Self-Driving (FSD) system is like the real-life version of Grand Theft Auto (GTA), describing the driving experience on actual roads.

According to Odaily, Tesla today sent FSD V15, a new driver-assistance software version, to some early-access users. The update includes a comprehensive upgrade to its end-to-end driving model and a new “Real-World View” feature. Using the vehicle’s cameras and training algorithms, the feature changes the display from icons representing cars, people and road obstacles to an AI-generated, real-time street view. GTA 6 was released this week and sold 32.5 million copies on its first day, generating about $3.79 billion in global revenue, the highest single-day sales for an entertainment product to date.

title: Elon Musk Says Tesla FSD Is a Real-Life GTA
